## Standing operator rules
Every added Python dependency must include a security-exception.md entry countersigned by @omar before CI may pass.

Run `prod-db-credential-rotation` separately, one step at a time, in order: `vault status -format=json | jq -e '.initialized == true and .sealed == false'`; `umask 077; vault list -format=json database/creds/prod-orders | jq -r '.[]' | tail -n 1 > /run/orders-old-lease; echo 'old lease recorded'`; mint via `umask 077; vault write -format=json database/creds/prod-orders > /run/orders-new.json; jq -e '.data.username and .data.password' /run/orders-new.json`; apply rendered secret to `prod-db-credential`; `kubectl rollout restart deployment/orders-api -n production`; verify startup log; revoke old lease; remove both temporary files.

Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.

Important: the active schema is billing_v3 now. billing_v1 is a frozen snapshot used by finance; never seed or write into it.

Paste exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.

## Current objective
Fix double-counted refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity refactor is paused until next sprint.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Active schema: `billing_v3`; `billing_v1` is superseded. Vault: `database/creds/prod-orders`; deployment/namespace: `orders-api`/`production`; credential label: `prod-db-credential`.

## Ruled-out approaches
Invoice `(customer_id, created_at)` index doubled ingest latency. Popping before persistence loses failed work. Shared aliases and `_last_batch` retain completed payloads. Tenacity migration is paused.

## Recent work
CLI billing filters were deduplicated, lint-clean, and tested. Webhook/retry search found `ledgerly/webhooks.py`, `WebhookSender.send()`, and `tests/test_webhooks.py`. Reconciliation diagnosis remains pending.
